name: PORTFOLIO

excluded.carry_gated: verifier pass, but at its capped 25% capital share ($50) the qty-rounded book is unhedged (vol 10-14%) and loses money on WF-OOS (-0.7% to -2.1% CAGR); adds only +0.03 Sharpe unrounded. Gets its own lockbox look as a sleeve, not in the $200 portfolio.

precommit.rule: inverse-vol risk weights on WF-OOS daily streams 2022-12-01..2025-06-27; combined weights = m * sum rw_s * w_s(vol_target=0.20); one run_weights sim, max_gross_leverage=5
precommit.recommendation_rule: highest menu level with WF-OOS maxDD >= -35% AND Sharpe-halved block-bootstrap P(-50% DD in 1y) <= 5% AND vol <= half-Kelly at the recent-regime Sharpe (~0.6 in 2024-25H1 -> 0.30). 0.25 passes all; 0.35 fails the DD test (-37.5%).

method.rule: inverse-vol risk weights on WF-OOS daily streams 2022-12-01..2025-06-27; combined weights = m * sum rw_s * w_s(vol_target=0.20); one run_weights sim, max_gross_leverage=5

method.vol_scaling: static multiplier m on the combined book, calibrated so the WF-OOS daily vol = target (each sleeve keeps its own 30d causal vol targeting inside); sim max_gross_leverage=5 caps targets
method.simulation: sim.run_weights on the 12-major 6h union panel: one account, opposite sleeve positions in the same coin net, Bybit taker fee + tiered slippage, Binance funding, cross-margin liquidation
method.wf_oos_weights: per fold, each sleeve's WF-chosen params (from its results JSON) on its test window; lockbox uses FROZEN params

implementability_200.symbol_mismatches: none: all 12 majors exist on Bybit linear under the same names (1000SHIB/SHIB1000-type renames only affect carry_gated / flowxs universes)
implementability_200.min_qty: BTC 0.001 lot binds: 49% of BTC orders dropped at WF-OOS prices (65% with the lot priced at ~$84k); ETH 0.01 lot drops 64% of ETH resizes; SOL 43%; other alts 13-30% ($5 min notional). Overall 32% dropped (37% at BTC $84k).

4_sleeve_return_series_incl_downgrades.note: return-series combination for context only (includes the two verifier downgrades); not simulated, not used, no lockbox look

headline: Lockbox at the recommended 25% vol: CAGR +7.7%, maxDD -27.0%, Sharpe 0.43, 2.4 round trips/day, 0 liquidations (BTC spot B&H -16.3% / -53.0%). WF-OOS was +40.7% / -28.3% / Sharpe 1.49 but decayed: 2023 Sharpe 2.6, 2024-25H1 0.59. Realistic forward: ~5-12%/yr at 25% vol; higher leverage adds drawdown, not return.

live_spec.account: Bybit demo, cross margin, USDT linear perps only; 12 symbols BTC ETH SOL BNB XRP DOGE ADA AVAX LINK LTC TRX DOT (USDT); symbol leverage setting 5x
live_spec.decision_rule: use the 6h bar that closed at :00; positions change only at runs; no resting/conditional entries; if the run starts >60 min after the close, micro_crowd target = 0 for that run
inputs: Binance fapi 6h klines (close, quote volume, taker-buy quote volume) >= 400 bars
Binance globalLongShortAccountRatio (5m) for 12 symbols: observation stamped <= close-5min, stored per 6h close locally (API keeps 30d; z needs 120 closes, min 60; backfill from data/hist/metrics)

sleeves.name: micro_crowd
sleeves.rule: pos = -sign(zG) if |zG|>=1.5 (zG = 120-close z of ln ls_ratio), 1-bar hold; inverse-vol/12; book to 20% vol on trailing 120-bar vol, gross cap 3; band 0.02

sleeves.name: micro_flowts
sleeves.rule: BTC only: residual z (360-bar OLS of 24h taker imbalance on 24h return) >= 0.5 -> long, averaged over last 12 decisions; inverse-vol, book to 20% vol, gross cap 3; band 0.05

live_spec.sizing: target_notional_j = E * 1.413318 * (0.477942*w_crowd_j + 0.522058*w_flowts_j); E = bot mark-to-market equity (starts at the $200 budget); sleeves net into one position per coin; if sum|target| > 5E scale down
live_spec.orders: market (taker IOC) to target; qty floored to qtyStep; skip if qty < minOrderQty or notional < $5 unless closing to 0; reduceOnly for cuts/closes; close-then-open on a sign flip; ~6 fills/day
live_spec.stop_loss: every perp position: mark-price stopLoss (tpslMode Full) at d = min(15%, 0.5/G) from avg entry, G = account gross after the run; always within half the cross-margin liquidation distance (1/G); re-set each run; catastrophe stop, NOT modelled in the backtest - do not tighten
kill_switches: HARD: E <= $150 (-25% of budget) -> flatten (market reduceOnly), cancel stops, halt, notify owner (never hit at 0.25 on OOS or lockbox)
PAUSE: drawdown from high-water mark >= 30% -> no new positions, book closed next run, owner review (worst seen -28.3% OOS / -27.0% lockbox)
DATA: ls_ratio older than 60 min -> that coin's crowd target 0; Binance klines missing -> flowts holds, no increase; Bybit vs Binance close > 1% apart -> skip run
REVIEW (owner): after 6 months, drop a sleeve whose live Sharpe < 0 AND is negative on a fresh walk-forward incl. new data; whole-book live Sharpe < 0 over 12 months -> stop
not_live: carry_gated ($50 slice cannot hold hedged pairs at Bybit lot sizes)

lab_findings: No new correctness bug found; verifier's list stands (runs-null turnover inflation; no resting-entry model in run_events; no dropped-order counter in run_weights - measured here by diffing rounded vs unrounded positions; per-leg adverse-extreme liquidation false-liquidates same-coin hedges).
Limitation: evaluate_lockbox scores a single account/panel, so a book mixing 1d spot carry and 6h perps cannot be evaluated as one account.
run_weights' 5x cap applies to targets; drifted gross reached 5.4-5.7x at the 0.50/0.70 levels (documented behaviour).
caveats: OOS 2.6y and lockbox 1.2y are short; t ~ 0.8 on the lockbox.
micro_flowts failed the lockbox (Sharpe -0.07) but stays in by the pre-committed rule; removing it on lockbox evidence would be lockbox selection.
micro_flowxs / trend_ens did better than flowts on the lockbox; that does not rehabilitate them (failed dev nulls; one window).
Fees are ~13-20% of equity/yr at 0.25 vs a net return of ~8%: pre-fee lockbox return ~28%/yr.
Stops, Bybit/Binance basis and funding differences, latency and partial fills are not modelled; relies on Binance public ls_ratio staying available.
REPORT.md could not be written: the harness blocks subagent .md report files; the plain-English report is in this JSON ('report') and in the final answer.

report.what_works: A 2-sleeve perp book (fade the Binance retail long/short ratio on 12 majors + BTC taker-flow long-only), inverse-vol weighted and run as one netted account. On the untouched 15-month lockbox at 25% vol it made +7.7%/yr, maxDD -27%, while BTC buy-and-hold lost -16%/yr with a -53% fall.
report.what_failed: micro_flowts failed the lockbox (-4.1%/yr); carry_gated earned nothing (funding near zero) and cannot be run on $200; 12 other modules failed before the lockbox (most lose money after fees, several before fees). The walk-forward +40.7%/yr was mostly 2023 (Sharpe 2.6); 2024-25H1 Sharpe 0.59, lockbox 0.43.
report.bad_month: At 25% vol on $200: a typical bad month is -5% to -8% (-$10 to -$16); the worst seen was -16.4% (-$33, Sep-2024). 42-47% of months are negative. On the lockbox the book peaked at $268 (Feb-2026) and fell 27% to ~$196 by Aug-2026 before ending at $219. About 38% of one-year windows lose money at the realistic Sharpe.
report.why_no_config_wins_every_trade: The book wins only 34-43% of round trips and profits because winners are bigger (profit factor 1.28 OOS, 1.06 lockbox). 90%+ win-rate systems (grids, DCA) get that by never closing losers. Sleeve leadership flipped between dev and lockbox, so 'always winning' configurations can only be built with hindsight. Fees (13-20%/yr of equity) eat most of a ~28%/yr pre-fee edge.
report.recommendation: Default 25% annual vol (m=1.4133), fixed before the lockbox by a written rule; it is ~half-Kelly at the lockbox Sharpe. 35% is defensible only if the owner accepts -35% to -40% drawdowns for ~+2 pts/yr; 50%+ adds drawdown without adding return.
